identity_limits: Original model declares a Tetun Dili fine-tune, but its actual training data URL and weights licence remainTBD.
Original 256-row token inventory includes required symbols, but existence/nonzero tensor rows do not prove learned native sound meanings.
Mechanical differing WAVs do not prove native phonetic contrasts. Primary listening/native-speaker review remains required.
All original model weights remain pinned and unchanged; no added IDs, substituted foreign phone, training or quantization.
native_constraints: Native h is a glottal fricative; do not drop initial h by Portuguese spelling rules.
Plain voiceless stops are unaspirated; final stops are generally unreleased. These surface features require actual carrier validation, not just token presence.
Stress is contrastive. Final stressed vowels are normally lengthened in the selected source realization; source also notes speaker variation and unresolved independent vowel length status.
No general penultimate-stress or all-vowels reduction rule is implemented.
Ordinary alphabet, punctuation and number names are not supplied.

source.licence: Online edition2015 CC-BY-SA4.0; conservative source notice retained for brief factual lexical entries.
source.title: Tetun Dili: A grammar of an East Timorese language

standard: Tetun Dili phonology in Williams-van Klinken/Hajek/Nordlinger2002; does not assert all Tetun standards or generic tet alias.
word_annotation: Acute marks below disambiguate the source lexical stress. They are explicit research input annotations, not claimed as universal ordinary INL/DIT spelling.
